original_interfaces.meaning: Internal TravelSystem.begin accepts traveller,destination and returns started + complete Journey path, route costs, future arrival handle; not safe to return raw to a learner
Original author asserts begin, blocked/access/no-route, arrival, multi-leg, restart continuity and future journey internals
CLI world run/verify and archival interface, not a learner-scoped public decision API
Original CLI is simulation driver until observer exists, no evidence of owner-approved learner interaction
Map occupancy and access/topology data source with potentially private information

control_scope.requires: one fixed authenticated learner-scoped actor; destination must be in pre-exposed original-owner approved public destination catalog; finite integer action budget; current actor not already in flight; no private route/hidden world state passed to the learner
control_scope.denied: Any unapproved owner-scoped destination, arbitrary route, seed, causes, target time, hidden property, candidate private registry, second actor, rights escalation, invented FSA GO, uncontrolled action count or surprise raw return data
control_scope.scoring_boundary: Action acceptance is NOT outcome or transfer; independently qualified scorer must own full hidden world state; learner only sees TW2's approved post-action observation projection
control_scope.return_policy: Original TravelSystem.begin or denied outcome contains route details/reasons. Never expose raw result; only a uniform receipt with submitted status from an authorized adapter (not implemented here). Real denied actions must still be counted in total budgets.
control_scope.strong_controls: Equal public action menu, identical action slots and observation stream for native learners and fully trained conventional controls; no budget asymmetry
control_scope.science: No source run, original action, independent permission, source-admitted cohort, hidden facts or learned behavior in TW3.

adversarial_cases: Reject candidate destinations not in owner-approved public allowlist
Reject actor mismatch and spoofed other actor
Reject arbitrary extra action fields including route/cost/future arrival
Reject negative or Boolean budgets and in-flight action conflict
Public allowlist not treated as proof actual destination exists or is accessible
Never return original Journey/path/arrival/cost or blocked detailed reasons
Keep result receipt identical regardless of private outcome internals
No original run, trainer, reset, seed, scorer or protected cohort accessed
Do not count static parentage or ownership as action-conditioned learning
